english.title: Fail to comply with environmental permitting notice in respect of flood risk activity

(B)_[a prohibition notice in respect of a flood risk activity]_
(C)_[a suspension notice in respect of a flood risk activity]_
(D)_[a landfill closure notice in respect of a flood risk activity]_
(E)_[a mining waste facility closure notice in respect of a flood risk activity]_
(F)_[a flood risk activity emergency works notice]_
(G)_[a flood risk activity remediation notice]_
